info.title: PreflightApi
info.description: Aviation data API for VFR flight planning — weather, airports, airspace, NOTAMs, navigation, and E6B flight computer calculations.

``` GET /api/v1/airports — all airports (paginated) GET /api/v1/airports?search=Dallas — text search across name, city, ICAO, and FAA identifier GET /api/v1/airports?state=TX — airports in Texas GET /api/v1/airports?state=TX,OK,LA — airports in multiple states GET /api/v1/airports?search=Regional&state=TX — combined search + state filter ```

post.summary:
Generates a composite weather briefing for a flight route. Accepts a list of waypoints
(airport identifiers or lat/lon coordinates) and returns all weather products affecting
the route corridor: METARs and TAFs for airports along the route, PIREPs within the
corridor, SIGMETs and G-AIRMETs intersecting the route, and active NOTAMs.
post.description:
Each waypoint is either an airport identifier (ICAO or FAA) or a lat/lon coordinate. At least two waypoints are required. The corridor width controls how far from the route centerline to search for PIREPs, airports, and NOTAMs (default 25 NM each side).

**Airport-only route**

``` { "waypoints": [ { "airportIdentifier": "KDFW" }, { "airportIdentifier": "KAUS" } ] } ```

**Mixed route with coordinate waypoints and custom corridor**

``` { "waypoints": [ { "airportIdentifier": "KDFW" }, { "latitude": 31.5, "longitude": -97.2 }, { "airportIdentifier": "KAUS" } ], "corridorWidthNm": 30 } ```

**Response Contents**

- `Metars` — latest METARs for airports within the corridor

- `Tafs` — current TAFs for airports within the corridor

- `Pireps` — pilot reports within the corridor

- `Sigmets` — active SIGMETs whose boundaries intersect the route

- `GAirmets` — active G-AIRMETs whose boundaries intersect the route

- `Notams` — active NOTAMs for airports along the route

requestBody.description:
Route definition containing Waypoints (minimum 2, each with AirportIdentifier
or Latitude/Longitude) and optional CorridorWidthNm (default 25).

400.description: If the request is invalid (fewer than 2 waypoints, invalid coordinates, etc.)

404.description: If an airport waypoint is not found

get.summary: Calculates crosswind and headwind components for every runway at an airport using live METAR wind data.
get.description:
Fetches the airport's latest METAR observation and computes wind components for each runway end. The response includes a `RecommendedRunway` — the runway end with the lowest crosswind that also has a headwind (not a tailwind).

**Sign Conventions**

- `CrosswindKt` — positive = wind from the right, negative = wind from the left

- `HeadwindKt` — positive = headwind (favorable), negative = tailwind (unfavorable)

If the METAR reports variable wind (VRB), `IsVariableWind` is true and crosswind components are calculated using the full wind speed for all runway ends. If gusts are reported, separate `GustCrosswindKt` and `GustHeadwindKt` fields show the worst-case gust components.

parameters.name: icaoCodeOrIdent
parameters.description: ICAO code (e.g., KDFW) or FAA identifier (e.g., DFW)

200.description: Returns crosswind data for all runways with a recommended runway

400.description: The METAR is missing wind direction or wind speed data

404.description: The airport was not found, or no current METAR is available for this airport

post.summary: Calculates crosswind and headwind components from manually provided wind and runway heading values.
post.description:
Provide wind direction, wind speed, and a runway heading to compute the headwind and crosswind components. Optionally include a gust speed to also compute gust components.

**Sign Conventions**

- `CrosswindKt` — positive = wind from the right, negative = wind from the left

- `HeadwindKt` — positive = headwind (favorable), negative = tailwind (unfavorable)

requestBody.description:
WindDirectionDegrees (0-360, or null for variable),
WindSpeedKt (knots),
WindGustKt (knots, optional),
RunwayHeadingDegrees (magnetic degrees, 0-360).

200.description: Returns the calculated crosswind and headwind components

400.description: The request parameters are invalid (e.g., wind speed is negative)

get.summary: Calculates density altitude for an airport using live METAR data with optional overrides.
get.description:
Fetches the airport's latest METAR to obtain temperature and altimeter setting, then computes density altitude using the ISA model. You can optionally override either value via query parameters for "what if" scenarios (e.g., "what would density altitude be if the temperature reached 40°C?").

**Response Fields**

- `DensityAltitudeFt` — the effective altitude the aircraft "feels" based on air density

- `PressureAltitudeFt` — field elevation corrected for non-standard pressure

- `IsaTemperatureCelsius` — the standard (ISA) temperature expected at this pressure altitude

- `TemperatureDeviationCelsius` — how far the actual temperature deviates from ISA (positive = hotter than standard)

*Formula:*`DA = PA + 120 * (OAT - ISA_temp)`. This does not account for humidity, local pressure patterns, or non-standard lapse rates.

parameters.name: icaoCodeOrIdent
parameters.description: ICAO code (e.g., KDFW) or FAA identifier (e.g., DFW)

parameters.name: TemperatureCelsiusOverride
parameters.description: Override temperature in Celsius (uses METAR if not provided)

parameters.name: AltimeterInHgOverride
parameters.description: Override altimeter setting in inHg (uses METAR if not provided)

200.description: Returns density altitude data for the airport

400.description: The METAR is missing temperature or altimeter data and no override was provided

404.description: The airport was not found, or no current METAR is available

post.summary: Calculates density altitude from manually provided field elevation, altimeter setting, and temperature.
post.description:
Provide your own values instead of relying on METAR data. Useful for any location, for planning with forecast temperatures, or when METAR data is not available.

**Response Fields**

- `DensityAltitudeFt` — the effective altitude the aircraft "feels" based on air density

- `PressureAltitudeFt` — field elevation corrected for non-standard pressure

- `IsaTemperatureCelsius` — the standard (ISA) temperature expected at this pressure altitude

- `TemperatureDeviationCelsius` — how far the actual temperature deviates from ISA (positive = hotter than standard)

*Formula:*`DA = PA + 120 * (OAT - ISA_temp)`. This does not account for humidity, local pressure patterns, or non-standard lapse rates.

requestBody.description:
FieldElevationFt (feet MSL),
AltimeterInHg (inches of mercury),
TemperatureCelsius (degrees Celsius).

400.description: The request parameters are invalid

post.summary: Solves the wind triangle to compute true heading and ground speed.
post.description:
Given your desired true course, true airspeed, and the wind conditions, this calculates the heading you need to fly to stay on course and your resulting ground speed.

**Response Fields**

- `TrueHeadingDegrees` — the heading to fly (true course + wind correction angle)

- `GroundSpeedKt` — your speed over the ground after accounting for wind

- `WindCorrectionAngleDegrees` — the crab angle needed to stay on course (positive = correct to the right, negative = correct to the left)

- `HeadwindComponentKt` — positive = headwind, negative = tailwind

- `CrosswindComponentKt` — positive = from the right, negative = from the left

Wind direction is the direction the wind is blowing *from* (standard meteorological convention).

requestBody.description:
TrueCourseDegrees (0-360),
TrueAirspeedKt (knots, must be greater than 0),
WindDirectionDegrees (0-360, direction wind blows from),
WindSpeedKt (knots).

400.description: The request parameters are invalid (e.g., TAS is zero or negative)

post.summary: Calculates true airspeed (TAS) from calibrated airspeed, pressure altitude, and outside air temperature.
post.description:
Uses the full compressible isentropic flow conversion (CAS to impact pressure to Mach to TAS), accurate from sea level through FL410+ including above the ISA tropopause at 36,089 ft. This is more accurate than the simplified `CAS / sqrt(sigma)` formula, which diverges significantly at higher altitudes.

**Response Fields**

- `TrueAirspeedKt` — the aircraft's actual speed through the air mass (knots)

- `DensityAltitudeFt` — density altitude at the given conditions (feet)

- `MachNumber` — the aircraft's speed as a fraction of the local speed of sound

*Note:* The ISA tropopause is modeled at 36,089 ft. The real tropopause varies from ~26,000 ft near the poles to ~55,000 ft near the equator, which affects accuracy at high altitudes in non-mid-latitude regions.

requestBody.description:
CalibratedAirspeedKt (knots, must be greater than 0),
PressureAltitudeFt (feet, can be negative),
OutsideAirTemperatureCelsius (degrees Celsius).

400.description: The request parameters are invalid (e.g., CAS is zero or negative)

post.summary: Estimates cloud base height AGL from surface temperature and dewpoint spread.
post.description:
Uses the standard pilot rule of thumb: `cloud base (ft AGL) = (temperature - dewpoint) * 400`. This approximates the lifting condensation level based on the average dry adiabatic lapse rate (~3°C/1000 ft) and dewpoint lapse rate (~0.5°C/1000 ft).

**Response Fields**

- `EstimatedCloudBaseFtAgl` — estimated height of the cloud base above ground level (feet)

- `TemperatureDewpointSpreadCelsius` — the difference between temperature and dewpoint (degrees Celsius)

*Note:* Actual cloud bases vary with humidity profiles, inversions, and local convective conditions. A small spread (less than 3°C) generally indicates a high likelihood of low ceilings or fog.

requestBody.description:
TemperatureCelsius (surface temperature in °C) and
DewpointCelsius (dewpoint in °C, must be less than or equal to the temperature).

400.description: The dewpoint exceeds the temperature, which is physically invalid

post.summary: Calculates pressure altitude from field elevation and altimeter setting.
post.description:
Pressure altitude is the altitude in the standard atmosphere where the pressure equals the current pressure at your location. It is the starting point for density altitude, TAS, and performance chart calculations.

*Formula:*`PA = FieldElevation + (29.92 - Altimeter) * 1000`

**Response Fields**

- `PressureAltitudeFt` — the calculated pressure altitude (feet)

- `AltimeterCorrectionFt` — the deviation from standard pressure expressed in feet (positive = lower pressure than standard, negative = higher)

*Note:* The 1 inHg = 1000 ft approximation is most accurate near sea level and diverges slightly at higher elevations and extreme altimeter settings.

requestBody.description:
FieldElevationFt (feet MSL) and
AltimeterInHg (inches of mercury, must be between 25.0 and 35.0).

400.description: The altimeter setting is outside the valid range (25.0 - 35.0 inHg)

post.summary: Calculates a complete VFR navigation log for a cross-country flight.
post.description:
Provide an ordered list of waypoints (minimum 2) with aircraft performance data, a cruising altitude, and a departure time. The service calculates every leg of the route and returns detailed per-leg data including course, heading, ground speed, distance, estimated time, fuel burn, and wind information.

**Automatic Waypoint Insertion**

The service automatically inserts calculated waypoints into the route to model climb and descent phases:

- **Top of Climb (TOC)** — Inserted after departure (or after a refueling stop) at the point where the aircraft reaches cruising altitude. Position is calculated using the climb true airspeed and climb rate from your performance data. Legs before the TOC use climb airspeed and climb fuel burn rate.

- **Top of Descent (TOD)** — Inserted before the destination (or before a refueling stop) at the point where the aircraft should begin descending. Calculated using descent airspeed, descent rate, and a 3 NM final approach buffer. Legs after the TOD use descent airspeed and descent fuel burn rate.

- **Bottom of Descent (BOD)** — Inserted 3 NM before the destination airport at Traffic Pattern Altitude (airport elevation + 1000 ft, rounded to the nearest 100 ft). This marks the point where the aircraft levels off at pattern altitude for the approach.

**Wind Correction**

The service automatically fetches winds aloft forecast data based on your departure time and selects the nearest reporting station to each waypoint. Wind direction, speed, and temperature are interpolated to the leg's altitude. The magnetic heading returned for each leg is the actual heading to fly after accounting for both magnetic variation and wind correction. If wind data is unavailable, the calculation proceeds with zero-wind assumptions (ground speed equals true airspeed).

**Fuel Tracking**

Fuel is tracked across the entire route. Start/Taxi/Takeoff (STT) fuel is deducted at departure and again after each refueling stop. Each leg burns fuel at the rate matching its phase (climb, cruise, or descent). The `RemainingFuelGals` field on each leg shows usable fuel remaining at the end of that leg. Refueling stops can either add a specific number of gallons or refuel to full capacity.

**Refueling Stops**

Any intermediate waypoint can be marked as a refueling stop. When a refueling stop is present, the route is segmented so that each segment gets its own independent TOC, TOD, and BOD waypoints. This models a real multi-leg flight where you climb out after each stop and descend into each landing.

**Airspace and Obstacle Detection**

After calculating the route, the service queries the database for controlled airspaces (Class B, C, D, E), special use airspaces (Restricted, Prohibited, MOA, Warning, Alert), and obstacles along the route corridor. The response includes identifier collections that you can use with other endpoints to retrieve full details:

- `AirspaceGlobalIds` — use with `GET /api/v1/airspaces/by-global-ids`

- `SpecialUseAirspaceGlobalIds` — use with `GET /api/v1/airspaces/special-use/by-global-ids`

- `ObstacleOasNumbers` — use with `POST /api/v1/obstacles/by-oas-numbers`

requestBody.description:
Navigation log request containing:
Waypoints (ordered route points with lat/lon/altitude, minimum 2),
PerformanceData (climb/cruise/descent airspeeds in knots, climb/descent rates in FPM,
fuel burn rates in GPH, STT fuel in gallons, and total fuel on board in gallons),
PlannedCruisingAltitude (feet MSL), and
TimeOfDeparture (UTC, used to select the appropriate winds aloft forecast).

400.description:
The request data is invalid. Common causes: fewer than 2 waypoints, missing performance data,
             or invalid coordinate values.

503.description:
An external service required for the calculation is temporarily unavailable.
             This can be the NOAA magnetic variation API or the winds aloft data source.

post.summary: Calculates the great-circle bearing and distance between two geographic points.
post.description:
Provide a start and end point as latitude/longitude in decimal degrees. The service computes:

- **True Course** — The initial bearing from start to end referenced to True North (0-360 degrees), computed using WGS84 geodesic (great-circle) geometry.

- **Magnetic Course** — The true course adjusted for local magnetic variation at the start point. This is the course you would read on a magnetic compass (0-360 degrees).

- **Distance** — The great-circle distance between the two points in nautical miles.

post.summary: Gets NOTAMs for a flight route (airports and/or waypoints).
post.description:
Queries NOTAMs for each point along a route, deduplicates them, and returns a single combined result.

**Option 1 — Airport identifiers only (simple)**

Provide a list of airport identifiers. Each airport is queried by identifier match (FAA or ICAO). Best for straightforward airport-to-airport routes with no en-route waypoints.

``` { "airportIdentifiers": ["KDFW", "KAUS"] } ```

**Option 2 — Route points (airports + waypoints)**

Provide an ordered list of route points. Each point is either an airport (queried by identifier) or a geographic waypoint (queried by spatial radius around its coordinates). Use this when your route includes en-route waypoints or you need per-point radius control.

``` { "routePoints": [ { "airportIdentifier": "KDFW" }, { "name": "Lake Travis", "latitude": 30.4082, "longitude": -97.8538 }, { "latitude": 30.1, "longitude": -97.6, "radiusNm": 15 }, { "airportIdentifier": "KAUS" } ], "corridorRadiusNm": 25, "filters": { "classification": "DOMESTIC", "feature": "RWY" } } ```

**How each point type is queried**

- **Airport points** — queried by identifier (same as the single-airport endpoint). Radius settings do not apply.

- **Waypoints** — queried by spatial radius. The radius used is: the point's own `radiusNm` if set, otherwise the request-level `corridorRadiusNm`, otherwise the server default (25 NM).

**Notes**

- If both `routePoints` and `airportIdentifiers` are provided, `routePoints` is used and `airportIdentifiers` is ignored.

- Duplicate NOTAMs appearing at multiple route points are returned only once.

- Optional `filters` (classification, feature, freeText, date range) are applied to every route point query.

siteNo.description: FAA NASR field: SITE_NO. Unique Site Number assigned by the FAA to identify the airport facility.

icaoId.description: FAA NASR field: ICAO_ID. ICAO (International Civil Aviation Organization) identifier (e.g., KDFW, KLAX).

arptId.description: FAA NASR field: ARPT_ID. FAA location identifier (e.g., DFW, LAX, ORD). Up to 4 characters.

arptName.description: FAA NASR field: ARPT_NAME. Official Facility Name.

effDate.description: FAA NASR field: EFF_DATE. Effective date of the airport information.

siteType.description: FAA NASR field: SITE_TYPE_CODE. Landing facility type.

ownershipType.description: FAA NASR field: OWNERSHIP_TYPE_CODE. Airport ownership type.

facilityUse.description: FAA NASR field: FACILITY_USE_CODE. Facility use designation.

arptStatus.description: FAA NASR field: ARPT_STATUS. Airport operational status.

naspCode.description: FAA NASR field: NASP_CODE. NPIAS/Federal Agreements Code. A combination of 1 to 7 codes indicating the type of Federal agreements existing at the Airport.

city.description: FAA NASR field: CITY. Associated city name for the airport.

stateCode.description: FAA NASR field: STATE_CODE. Two-letter USPS state code where the airport is located.

countryCode.description: FAA NASR field: COUNTRY_CODE. Two-letter country code.

stateName.description: FAA NASR field: STATE_NAME. Full state name where the airport is located.

regionCode.description: FAA NASR field: REGION_CODE. FAA region code (e.g., ASW, AEA, AWP).

adoCode.description: FAA NASR field: ADO_CODE. FAA Airports District Office code.

countyName.description: FAA NASR field: COUNTY_NAME. County name where the airport is located.

countyAssocState.description: FAA NASR field: COUNTY_ASSOC_STATE. Two-letter state, territory, or country code associated with the county (e.g., US state codes, CN for Canada, GU for Guam, VI for Virgin Islands).

distCityToAirport.description: FAA NASR field: DIST_CITY_TO_AIRPORT. Distance from Central Business District of the Associated City to the Airport.

directionCode.description: FAA NASR field: DIRECTION_CODE. Direction of Airport from Central Business District of Associated City (Nearest 1/8 Compass Point).

acreage.description: FAA NASR field: ACREAGE. Land Area Covered by Airport (Acres).

latDecimal.description: FAA NASR field: LAT_DECIMAL. Latitude of airport reference point in decimal degrees.

longDecimal.description: FAA NASR field: LONG_DECIMAL. Longitude of airport reference point in decimal degrees.

latDeg.description: FAA NASR field: LAT_DEG. Latitude degrees of airport reference point.

latMin.description: FAA NASR field: LAT_MIN. Latitude minutes of airport reference point.

latSec.description: FAA NASR field: LAT_SEC. Latitude seconds of airport reference point.

latHemis.description: FAA NASR field: LAT_HEMIS. Latitude hemisphere of airport reference point (N or S).

longDeg.description: FAA NASR field: LONG_DEG. Longitude degrees of airport reference point.

longMin.description: FAA NASR field: LONG_MIN. Longitude minutes of airport reference point.

longSec.description: FAA NASR field: LONG_SEC. Longitude seconds of airport reference point.

longHemis.description: FAA NASR field: LONG_HEMIS. Longitude hemisphere of airport reference point (E or W).

positionSurveyMethod.description: FAA NASR field: SURVEY_METHOD_CODE. Method used to determine the airport reference point position.

arptPsnSource.description: FAA NASR field: ARPT_PSN_SOURCE. Source of the airport position information.

positionSrcDate.description: FAA NASR field: POSITION_SRC_DATE. Date the airport position information was determined.

elev.description: FAA NASR field: ELEV. Airport elevation in feet MSL, to the nearest tenth of a foot. Measured at the highest point on the centerline of the usable landing surface.

elevationSurveyMethod.description: FAA NASR field: ELEV_METHOD_CODE. Method used to determine the airport elevation.

arptElevSource.description: FAA NASR field: ARPT_ELEV_SOURCE. Source of the airport elevation information.

elevationSrcDate.description: FAA NASR field: ELEVATION_SRC_DATE. Date the airport elevation information was determined.

magVarn.description: FAA NASR field: MAG_VARN. Magnetic Variation in degrees.

magHemis.description: FAA NASR field: MAG_HEMIS. Magnetic Variation Direction (E or W).

magVarnYear.description: FAA NASR field: MAG_VARN_YEAR. Magnetic Variation Epoch Year.

tpa.description: FAA NASR field: TPA. Traffic Pattern Altitude (Whole Feet AGL).

chartName.description: FAA NASR field: CHART_NAME. Sectional aeronautical chart name on which the airport appears.

respArtccId.description: FAA NASR field: RESP_ARTCC_ID. Responsible ARTCC Identifier. The Responsible ARTCC is the FAA Air Route Traffic Control Center that has control over the Airport.

artccName.description: FAA NASR field: ARTCC_NAME. Name of the responsible ARTCC.

twrTypeCode.description: FAA NASR field: TWR_TYPE_CODE. Air Traffic Control Tower Facility Type (ATCT, NON-ATCT, ATCT-A/C, ATCT-RAPCON, ATCT-RATCF, ATCT-TRACON, TRACON).

fssOnAirport.description: FAA NASR field: FSS_ON_ARPT_FLAG. Tie-In FSS Physically Located On Facility.

fssId.description: FAA NASR field: FSS_ID. Tie-In Flight Service Station (FSS) Identifier.

fssName.description: FAA NASR field: FSS_NAME. Tie-In FSS Name.

fssPhoneNumber.description: FAA NASR field: PHONE_NO. Local Phone Number from Airport to FSS for Administrative Services.

tollFreeNumber.description: FAA NASR field: TOLL_FREE_NO. Toll Free Phone Number from Airport to FSS for Pilot Briefing Services.

altFssId.description: FAA NASR field: ALT_FSS_ID. Alternate FSS Identifier. Identifies a full-time FSS that assumes responsibility during the off hours of a part-time primary FSS.

altFssName.description: FAA NASR field: ALT_FSS_NAME. Alternate Flight Service Station name.

altTollFreeNumber.description: FAA NASR field: ALT_TOLL_FREE_NO. Toll Free Phone Number from Airport to Alternate FSS for Pilot Briefing Services.

notamId.description: FAA NASR field: NOTAM_ID. Identifier of the Facility responsible for issuing NOTAMs and Weather information for the Airport.

notamAvailable.description: FAA NASR field: NOTAM_FLAG. Availability of NOTAM 'D' Service at Airport.

customsPortOfEntry.description: FAA NASR field: CUST_FLAG. Facility designated by U.S. Department of Homeland Security as an International Airport of Entry for Customs.

customsLandingRights.description: FAA NASR field: LNDG_RIGHTS_FLAG. Facility designated by U.S. Department of Homeland Security as a Customs Landing Rights Airport.

jointUse.description: FAA NASR field: JOINT_USE_FLAG. Facility has Military/Civil Joint Use Agreement that allows Civil Operations at a Military Airport.

militaryLandingRights.description: FAA NASR field: MIL_LNDG_FLAG. Airport has entered into an Agreement that Grants Landing Rights to the Military.

inspectionMethod.description: FAA NASR field: INSPECT_METHOD_CODE. Airport inspection method.

inspectorAgency.description: FAA NASR field: INSPECTOR_CODE. Agency/Group Performing Physical Inspection.

lastInspection.description: FAA NASR field: LAST_INSPECTION. Date of the last physical inspection.

lastInfoResponse.description: FAA NASR field: LAST_INFO_RESPONSE. Date of the last information request response.

fuelTypes.description: FAA NASR field: FUEL_TYPES. Fuel Types available for public use at the Airport (e.g., 100LL, A, A+, MOGAS, UL94).

contractFuelAvailable.description: FAA NASR field: CONTR_FUEL_AVBL. Whether contract fuel is available.

airframeRepairService.description: FAA NASR field: AIRFRAME_REPAIR_SER_CODE. Airframe repair service availability.

powerPlantRepairService.description: FAA NASR field: PWR_PLANT_REPAIR_SER. Power plant (engine) repair service availability.

bottledOxygenType.description: FAA NASR field: BOTTLED_OXY_TYPE. Type of bottled oxygen available.

bulkOxygenType.description: FAA NASR field: BULK_OXY_TYPE. Type of bulk oxygen available.

otherServices.description: FAA NASR field: OTHER_SERVICES. Other airport services available (comma-separated codes).

transientStorageBuoys.description: FAA NASR field: TRNS_STRG_BUOY_FLAG. Whether transient storage buoys are available.

transientStorageHangars.description: FAA NASR field: TRNS_STRG_HGR_FLAG. Whether transient storage hangars are available.

transientStorageTiedowns.description: FAA NASR field: TRNS_STRG_TIE_FLAG. Whether transient storage tie-downs are available.

lgtSked.description: FAA NASR field: LGT_SKED. Airport Lighting Schedule. Beginning-ending times (local time) that Standard Airport Lights are operated. Value can be 'SS-SR' (sunset-sunrise), blank, or 'SEE RMK'.

bcnLgtSked.description: FAA NASR field: BCN_LGT_SKED. Beacon Lighting Schedule. Beginning-ending times (local time) that the Rotating Airport Beacon Light is operated. Value can be 'SS-SR' (sunset-sunrise), blank, or 'SEE RMK'.

beaconLensColor.description: FAA NASR field: BCN_LENS_COLOR. Airport beacon lens color.

segmentedCircleMarker.description: FAA NASR field: SEG_CIRCLE_MKR_FLAG. Segmented circle airport marker system.

windIndicator.description: FAA NASR field: WIND_INDCR_FLAG. Wind indicator type.

landingFee.description: FAA NASR field: LNDG_FEE_FLAG. Landing Fee charged to Non-Commercial Users of Airport.

medicalUse.description: FAA NASR field: MEDICAL_USE_FLAG. Indicates that the Landing Facility is used for Medical Purposes.

activationDate.description: FAA NASR field: ACTIVATION_DATE. Airport Activation Date (YYYY/MM). Year and month the facility was added to the NFDC airport database. Only available for facilities opened since 1981.

minOpNetwork.description: FAA NASR field: MIN_OP_NETWORK. Minimum Operational Network (MON) designation.

userFeeFlag.description: FAA NASR field: USER_FEE_FLAG. US Customs User Fee Airport designation.

cta.description: FAA NASR field: CTA. Cold Temperature Airport. Altitude correction required at or below the temperature given in Celsius.

computerId.description: FAA NASR field: COMPUTER_ID. Responsible ARTCC (FAA) Computer Identifier.

far139TypeCode.description: FAA NASR field: FAR_139_TYPE_CODE. Airport ARFF Certification Type Code. Format is class code (I/II/III/IV) followed by A/B/C/D/E (full certificate) or L (limited certification). Blank if not certificated.

far139CarrierSerCode.description: FAA NASR field: FAR_139_CARRIER_SER_CODE. Airport ARFF Certification Carrier Service Code. S (scheduled service) or U (not receiving scheduled service).

arffCertTypeDate.description: FAA NASR field: ARFF_CERT_TYPE_DATE. Airport ARFF Certification Date (YYYY/MM).

aspAnalysisDtrmCode.description: FAA NASR field: ASP_ANLYS_DTRM_CODE. Airport Airspace Analysis Determination (CONDL, NOT ANALYZED, NO OBJECTION, OBJECTIONABLE).

skedSeqNo.description: FAA NASR field: SKED_SEQ_NO (APT_ATT). Attendance Schedule Sequence Number.

attendanceMonth.description: FAA NASR field: MONTH (APT_ATT). Months the facility is attended. May contain 'UNATNDD' for unattended facilities.

attendanceDay.description: FAA NASR field: DAY (APT_ATT). Days of the week the facility is open.

attendanceHours.description: FAA NASR field: HOUR (APT_ATT). Hours within the day the facility is attended.

contactTitle.description: FAA NASR field: TITLE (APT_CON). Title of the facility contact (e.g., MANAGER, OWNER).

contactName.description: FAA NASR field: NAME (APT_CON). Facility contact name.

contactAddress1.description: FAA NASR field: ADDRESS1 (APT_CON). Contact address line 1.

contactAddress2.description: FAA NASR field: ADDRESS2 (APT_CON). Contact address line 2.

contactCity.description: FAA NASR field: TITLE_CITY (APT_CON). Contact city.

contactState.description: FAA NASR field: STATE (APT_CON). Contact state.

contactZipCode.description: FAA NASR field: ZIP_CODE (APT_CON). Contact ZIP code.

contactZipPlusFour.description: FAA NASR field: ZIP_PLUS_FOUR (APT_CON). Contact ZIP+4 code.

contactPhoneNumber.description: FAA NASR field: PHONE_NO (APT_CON). Contact phone number.

AirportSiteType.description: Landing Facility Site Type. Corresponds to FAA NASR field SITE_TYPE_CODE (APT_BASE).

AirportOwnershipType.description: Airport Ownership Type. Corresponds to FAA NASR field OWNERSHIP_TYPE_CODE (APT_BASE).

AirportFacilityUse.description: Airport Facility Use. Corresponds to FAA NASR field FACILITY_USE_CODE (APT_BASE).

AirportStatus.description: Airport Operational Status. Corresponds to FAA NASR field ARPT_STATUS (APT_BASE).

SurveyMethod.description: Survey Method for position or elevation determination. Corresponds to FAA NASR fields SURVEY_METHOD_CODE and ELEV_METHOD_CODE (APT_BASE).

AirportInspectionMethod.description: Airport Inspection Method. Corresponds to FAA NASR field INSPECT_METHOD_CODE (APT_BASE).

AirportInspectorAgency.description: Airport Inspector Agency. Corresponds to FAA NASR field INSPECTOR_CODE (APT_BASE).

RepairServiceAvailability.description: Repair Service Availability. Corresponds to FAA NASR fields AIRFRAME_REPAIR_SER_CODE and PWR_PLANT_REPAIR_SER (APT_BASE).

OxygenPressureType.description: Oxygen Pressure Type. Corresponds to FAA NASR fields BOTTLED_OXY_TYPE and BULK_OXY_TYPE (APT_BASE).

BeaconLensColor.description: Airport Beacon Lens Color. Corresponds to FAA NASR field BCN_LENS_COLOR (APT_BASE).

SegmentedCircleMarkerType.description: Segmented Circle Airport Marker. Corresponds to FAA NASR field SEG_CIRCLE_MKR_FLAG (APT_BASE).

WindIndicatorType.description: Wind Indicator Type. Corresponds to FAA NASR field WIND_INDCR_FLAG (APT_BASE).

PaginationMetadata.description:
Metadata for cursor-based pagination. Use nextCursor as the cursor query parameter
to fetch the next page of results. When hasMore is false, there are no more pages.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor value to pass as the cursor query parameter to fetch the next page. Null when there are no more results.

hasMore.description: True if more results are available beyond this page; false if this is the last page.

limit.description: Maximum number of items returned per page (1-500, default 100).

ApiErrorResponse.description: Standardized error response format for API errors.

message.description: Human-readable error message suitable for display.

details.description: Additional error details (only included in development environment).

validationErrors.description: Field-level validation errors (only for validation failures).

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp when the error occurred.

traceId.description: Correlation ID for tracing the request.

path.description: Request path that generated the error.

RunwayDto.description:
Runway data from the FAA NASR database, sourced from APT_RWY.
Includes dimensions, surface, lighting, and weight-bearing information.

runwayId.description: FAA NASR field: RWY_ID. Runway identification (e.g., "01/19", "09L/27R", "H1" for helipad).

length.description: FAA NASR field: RWY_LEN. Physical runway length to the nearest foot.

width.description: FAA NASR field: RWY_WIDTH. Physical runway width to the nearest foot.

surfaceType.description:
FAA NASR field: SURFACE_TYPE_CODE. Runway surface type.
Common values: Concrete (CONC), Asphalt (ASPH), Turf (TURF), Dirt (DIRT), Gravel (GRAVEL), Water (WATER).

surfaceTreatment.description:
FAA NASR field: TREATMENT_CODE. Runway surface treatment.
Possible values: Grooved (GRVD), PorousFrictionCourse (PFC), AggregateFrictionSealCoat (AFSC),
RubberizedFrictionSealCoat (RFSC), WireComb (WC), None (NONE).

pavementClassification.description: FAA NASR field: PCN. Pavement Classification Number. See FAA Advisory Circular 150/5335-5 for code definitions and PCN determination formula.

edgeLightIntensity.description:
FAA NASR field: RWY_LGT_CODE. Runway lights edge intensity.
Possible values: High (HIGH), Medium (MED), Low (LOW), Flood (FLD), NonStandard (NSTD), Perimeter (PERI), Strobe (STRB), None (NONE).

weightBearingSingleWheel.description: FAA NASR field: GROSS_WT_SW. Runway weight-bearing capacity for single wheel type landing gear, in pounds.

weightBearingDualWheel.description: FAA NASR field: GROSS_WT_DW. Runway weight-bearing capacity for dual wheel type landing gear, in pounds.

weightBearingDualTandem.description: FAA NASR field: GROSS_WT_DTW. Runway weight-bearing capacity for two dual wheels in tandem type landing gear, in pounds.

weightBearingDoubleDualTandem.description: FAA NASR field: GROSS_WT_DDTW. Runway weight-bearing capacity for two dual wheels in tandem/two dual wheels in double tandem body gear type landing gear, in pounds.

surfaceCondition.description:
FAA NASR field: COND. Runway Surface Condition.
Possible values: EXCELLENT, GOOD, FAIR, POOR, FAILED.

pavementTypeCode.description:
FAA NASR field: PAVEMENT_TYPE_CODE. Pavement Type.
Possible values: R (Rigid), F (Flexible).

subgradeStrengthCode.description: FAA NASR field: SUBGRADE_STRENGTH_CODE. Subgrade Strength (Letters A-F).

tirePressureCode.description: FAA NASR field: TIRE_PRES_CODE. Tire Pressure Code (Letters W-Z).

determinationMethodCode.description:
FAA NASR field: DTRM_METHOD_CODE. Determination Method for pavement strength.
Possible values: T (Technical), U (Using Aircraft).

runwayLengthSource.description: FAA NASR field: RWY_LEN_SOURCE. Source of runway length information.

lengthSourceDate.description: FAA NASR field: LENGTH_SOURCE_DATE. Date of runway length source information.

runwayEnds.description: Runway end details for each direction (typically two per runway).

RunwaySurfaceType.description:
Runway Surface Type. Corresponds to FAA NASR field SURFACE_TYPE_CODE (APT_RWY).
The value will usually be one of the common types or a combination of two types
when the runway is composed of distinct sections.

RunwaySurfaceTreatment.description: Runway Surface Treatment. Corresponds to FAA NASR field TREATMENT_CODE (APT_RWY).

RunwayEdgeLightIntensity.description: Runway Lights Edge Intensity. Corresponds to FAA NASR field RWY_LGT_CODE (APT_RWY).

RunwayEndDto.description:
Runway end data from the FAA NASR database, sourced from APT_RWY_END.
Includes approach, markings, lighting, and controlling obstacle information.

runwayEndId.description: FAA NASR field: RWY_END_ID. Runway end identifier (e.g., "01", "19", "09L", "27R").

trueAlignment.description: FAA NASR field: TRUE_ALIGNMENT. Runway end true alignment. True heading of the runway to the nearest degree.

approachType.description:
FAA NASR field: ILS_TYPE. Instrument Landing System (ILS) type.
Possible values: Ils (ILS), Mls (MLS), Sdf (SDF), Localizer (LOCALIZER), Lda (LDA), Ismls (ISMLS),
IlsDme (ILS/DME), SdfDme (SDF/DME), LocDme (LOC/DME), LocGs (LOC/GS), LdaDme (LDA/DME).

rightHandTrafficPattern.description: FAA NASR field: RIGHT_HAND_TRAFFIC_PAT_FLAG. Whether right-hand traffic pattern is in effect for landing aircraft.

markingsType.description:
FAA NASR field: RWY_MARKING_TYPE_CODE. Runway markings type.
Possible values: PrecisionInstrument (PIR), NonPrecisionInstrument (NPI), Basic (BSC),
NumbersOnly (NRS), NonStandard (NSTD), Buoys (BUOY), Stol (STOL), None (NONE).

markingsCondition.description:
FAA NASR field: RWY_MARKING_COND. Runway markings condition.
Possible values: Good (G), Fair (F), Poor (P).

latitude.description: FAA NASR field: LAT_DECIMAL. Latitude of physical runway end in decimal degrees.

longitude.description: FAA NASR field: LONG_DECIMAL. Longitude of physical runway end in decimal degrees.

elevation.description: FAA NASR field: RWY_END_ELEV. Elevation at the physical runway end in feet MSL.

thresholdCrossingHeight.description: FAA NASR field: THR_CROSSING_HGT. Threshold Crossing Height in feet AGL. Height that the effective visual glide path crosses above the runway threshold.

visualGlidePathAngle.description: FAA NASR field: VISUAL_GLIDE_PATH_ANGLE. Visual glide path angle in hundredths of degrees.

displacedThresholdLatitude.description: FAA NASR field: LAT_DISPLACED_THR_DECIMAL. Latitude of displaced threshold in decimal degrees.

displacedThresholdLongitude.description: FAA NASR field: LONG_DISPLACED_THR_DECIMAL. Longitude of displaced threshold in decimal degrees.

displacedThresholdElevation.description: FAA NASR field: DISPLACED_THR_ELEV. Elevation at the displaced threshold in feet MSL.

displacedThresholdLength.description: FAA NASR field: DISPLACED_THR_LEN. Displaced threshold length in feet from the runway end.

touchdownZoneElevation.description: FAA NASR field: TDZ_ELEV. Elevation at the touchdown zone in feet MSL.

visualGlideSlopeIndicator.description:
FAA NASR field: VGSI_CODE. Visual Glide Slope Indicator type.
Common types: VASI (V2L/V4L/etc.), PAPI (P2L/P4L/etc.), SAVASI (S2L/S2R), Tri-Color, Pulsating, Panel systems.

runwayVisualRangeEquipment.description:
FAA NASR field: RWY_VISUAL_RANGE_EQUIP_CODE. Runway Visual Range (RVR) equipment location.
Possible values: Touchdown (T), Midfield (M), Rollout (R), None (N), TouchdownMidfield (TM), TouchdownRollout (TR), MidfieldRollout (MR), TouchdownMidfieldRollout (TMR).

runwayVisibilityValueEquipment.description: FAA NASR field: RWY_VSBY_VALUE_EQUIP_FLAG. Whether Runway Visibility Value (RVV) equipment is installed.

approachLightSystem.description:
FAA NASR field: APCH_LGT_SYSTEM_CODE. Approach light system type.
See ApproachLightSystemType enum for all possible values and their FAA descriptions.

hasRunwayEndLights.description: FAA NASR field: RWY_END_LGTS_FLAG. Whether Runway End Identifier Lights (REIL) are installed.

hasCenterlineLights.description: FAA NASR field: CNTRLN_LGTS_AVBL_FLAG. Whether runway centerline lights are installed.

hasTouchdownZoneLights.description: FAA NASR field: TDZ_LGT_AVBL_FLAG. Whether runway end touchdown zone lights are installed.

controllingObjectDescription.description: FAA NASR field: OBSTN_TYPE. Controlling object description (type of obstacle).

controllingObjectMarking.description:
FAA NASR field: OBSTN_MRKD_CODE. Controlling object marked/lighted status.
Possible values: Marked (M), Lighted (L), MarkedAndLighted (ML), None (NONE).

controllingObjectClearanceSlope.description: FAA NASR field: OBSTN_CLNC_SLOPE. Controlling object clearance slope value, expressed as a ratio of N:1. If greater than 50:1, then 50 is entered.

controllingObjectHeightAboveRunway.description: FAA NASR field: OBSTN_HGT. Controlling object height above the physical runway end in feet AGL.

controllingObjectDistanceFromRunway.description: FAA NASR field: DIST_FROM_THR. Controlling object distance from the physical runway end in feet.

controllingObjectCenterlineOffset.description: FAA NASR field: CNTRLN_OFFSET. Controlling object centerline offset distance in feet from the extended runway centerline.

rwyEndLatDeg.description: FAA NASR field: RWY_END_LAT_DEG. Runway end latitude degrees.

rwyEndLatMin.description: FAA NASR field: RWY_END_LAT_MIN. Runway end latitude minutes.

rwyEndLatSec.description: FAA NASR field: RWY_END_LAT_SEC. Runway end latitude seconds.

rwyEndLatHemis.description: FAA NASR field: RWY_END_LAT_HEMIS. Runway end latitude hemisphere (N or S).

rwyEndLongDeg.description: FAA NASR field: RWY_END_LONG_DEG. Runway end longitude degrees.

rwyEndLongMin.description: FAA NASR field: RWY_END_LONG_MIN. Runway end longitude minutes.

rwyEndLongSec.description: FAA NASR field: RWY_END_LONG_SEC. Runway end longitude seconds.

rwyEndLongHemis.description: FAA NASR field: RWY_END_LONG_HEMIS. Runway end longitude hemisphere (E or W).

displacedThrLatDeg.description: FAA NASR field: DISPLACED_THR_LAT_DEG. Displaced threshold latitude degrees.

displacedThrLatMin.description: FAA NASR field: DISPLACED_THR_LAT_MIN. Displaced threshold latitude minutes.

displacedThrLatSec.description: FAA NASR field: DISPLACED_THR_LAT_SEC. Displaced threshold latitude seconds.

displacedThrLatHemis.description: FAA NASR field: DISPLACED_THR_LAT_HEMIS. Displaced threshold latitude hemisphere (N or S).

displacedThrLongDeg.description: FAA NASR field: DISPLACED_THR_LONG_DEG. Displaced threshold longitude degrees.

displacedThrLongMin.description: FAA NASR field: DISPLACED_THR_LONG_MIN. Displaced threshold longitude minutes.

displacedThrLongSec.description: FAA NASR field: DISPLACED_THR_LONG_SEC. Displaced threshold longitude seconds.

displacedThrLongHemis.description: FAA NASR field: DISPLACED_THR_LONG_HEMIS. Displaced threshold longitude hemisphere (E or W).

farPart77Code.description:
FAA NASR field: FAR_PART_77_CODE. FAA CFR Part 77 (Objects Affecting Navigable Airspace) Runway Category.
Possible values: A(V) (Utility Runway with Visual Approach), B(V) (Other Than Utility with Visual Approach),
A(NP) (Utility with Nonprecision Approach), C (Other Than Utility with Nonprecision, visibility > 3/4 mile),
D (Other Than Utility with Nonprecision, visibility as low as 3/4 mile), PIR (Precision Instrument Runway).

centerlineDirectionCode.description: FAA NASR field: CNTRLN_DIR_CODE. Controlling Object Centerline Offset Direction. Indicates direction (left or right) to the object from the centerline as seen by an approaching pilot.

runwayGradient.description: FAA NASR field: RWY_GRAD. Runway End Gradient.

runwayGradientDirection.description: FAA NASR field: RWY_GRAD_DIRECTION. Runway End Gradient Direction (Up or Down).

rwyEndPositionSource.description: FAA NASR field: RWY_END_PSN_SOURCE. Source of runway end position information.

rwyEndPositionDate.description: FAA NASR field: RWY_END_PSN_DATE. Date of runway end position information.

rwyEndElevationSource.description: FAA NASR field: RWY_END_ELEV_SOURCE. Source of runway end elevation information.

rwyEndElevationDate.description: FAA NASR field: RWY_END_ELEV_DATE. Date of runway end elevation information.

displacedThrPositionSource.description: FAA NASR field: DSPL_THR_PSN_SOURCE. Source of displaced threshold position information.

displacedThrPositionDate.description: FAA NASR field: RWY_END_DSPL_THR_PSN_DATE. Date of displaced threshold position information.

displacedThrElevationSource.description: FAA NASR field: DSPL_THR_ELEV_SOURCE. Source of displaced threshold elevation information.

displacedThrElevationDate.description: FAA NASR field: RWY_END_DSPL_THR_ELEV_DATE. Date of displaced threshold elevation information.

touchdownZoneElevSource.description: FAA NASR field: TDZ_ELEV_SOURCE. Source of touchdown zone elevation information.

touchdownZoneElevDate.description: FAA NASR field: RWY_END_TDZ_ELEV_DATE. Date of touchdown zone elevation information.

takeoffRunAvailable.description: FAA NASR field: TKOF_RUN_AVBL. Takeoff Run Available (TORA) in feet.

takeoffDistanceAvailable.description: FAA NASR field: TKOF_DIST_AVBL. Takeoff Distance Available (TODA) in feet.

accelerateStopDistAvailable.description: FAA NASR field: ACLT_STOP_DIST_AVBL. Accelerate-Stop Distance Available (ASDA) in feet.

landingDistanceAvailable.description: FAA NASR field: LNDG_DIST_AVBL. Landing Distance Available (LDA) in feet.

lahsoAvailableLandingDistance.description: FAA NASR field: LAHSO_ALD. Available Landing Distance for Land and Hold Short Operations (LAHSO), in feet.

lahsoIntersectingRunway.description: FAA NASR field: RWY_END_INTERSECT_LAHSO. ID of Intersecting Runway Defining Hold Short Point.

lahsoDescription.description: FAA NASR field: LAHSO_DESC. Description of Entity Defining Hold Short Point if not an Intersecting Runway.

lahsoLatitude.description: FAA NASR field: LAHSO_LAT. LAHSO hold short point latitude (DMS format).

lahsoLatDecimal.description: FAA NASR field: LAT_LAHSO_DECIMAL. LAHSO hold short point latitude in decimal degrees.

lahsoLongitude.description: FAA NASR field: LAHSO_LONG. LAHSO hold short point longitude (DMS format).

lahsoLongDecimal.description: FAA NASR field: LONG_LAHSO_DECIMAL. LAHSO hold short point longitude in decimal degrees.

lahsoPositionSource.description: FAA NASR field: LAHSO_PSN_SOURCE. Source of LAHSO position information.

lahsoPositionDate.description: FAA NASR field: RWY_END_LAHSO_PSN_DATE. Date of LAHSO position information.

InstrumentApproachType.description: Instrument Landing System (ILS) Type. Corresponds to FAA NASR field ILS_TYPE (APT_RWY_END).

RunwayMarkingsType.description: Runway Markings Type. Corresponds to FAA NASR field RWY_MARKING_TYPE_CODE (APT_RWY_END).

RunwayMarkingsCondition.description: Runway Markings Condition. Corresponds to FAA NASR field RWY_MARKING_COND (APT_RWY_END).

VisualGlideSlopeIndicatorType.description: Visual Glide Slope Indicators. Corresponds to FAA NASR field VGSI_CODE (APT_RWY_END).

RunwayVisualRangeEquipmentType.description: Runway Visual Range (RVR) Equipment Location. Corresponds to FAA NASR field RWY_VISUAL_RANGE_EQUIP_CODE (APT_RWY_END).

ApproachLightSystemType.description: Approach Light System. Corresponds to FAA NASR field APCH_LGT_SYSTEM_CODE (APT_RWY_END).

ControllingObjectMarking.description: Controlling Object Marked/Lighted. Corresponds to FAA NASR field OBSTN_MRKD_CODE (APT_RWY_END).

PaginatedResponseOfAirspaceDto.description:
Cursor-based paginated response wrapper. To retrieve subsequent pages, pass the
pagination.nextCursor value as the cursor query parameter in your next request.
Continue until pagination.hasMore is false.

pagination.description: Pagination metadata including the cursor to fetch the next page.

AirspaceDto.description:
Controlled airspace data (Class B, C, D, E) sourced from FAA ArcGIS.
Use the GlobalId to cross-reference with navigation log results — the navlog response's
AirspaceGlobalIds field contains GlobalIds from this endpoint for airspaces along a planned route.

globalId.description: ArcGIS global unique identifier. This is the key used to look up airspaces returned by the navigation log endpoint's AirspaceGlobalIds field.

upperUom.description: Upper altitude unit of measure (e.g., FT, FL).

upperCode.description: Upper altitude reference code (e.g., MSL, AGL).

lowerUom.description: Lower altitude unit of measure (e.g., FT, FL).

lowerCode.description: Lower altitude reference code (e.g., MSL, AGL).

class.description: Airspace class (e.g., B, C, D, E).

GeoJsonGeometry.description: GeoJSON geometry representing an airspace boundary.

coordinates.description: Coordinate array defining the geometry boundary.

PaginatedResponseOfSpecialUseAirspaceDto.description:
Cursor-based paginated response wrapper. To retrieve subsequent pages, pass the
pagination.nextCursor value as the cursor query parameter in your next request.
Continue until pagination.hasMore is false.

pagination.description: Pagination metadata including the cursor to fetch the next page.

SpecialUseAirspaceDto.description:
Special use airspace data (restricted, prohibited, warning, MOA, alert) sourced from FAA ArcGIS.
Use the GlobalId to cross-reference with navigation log results — the navlog response's
SpecialUseAirspaceGlobalIds field contains GlobalIds from this endpoint for special use airspaces along a planned route.

globalId.description: ArcGIS global unique identifier. This is the key used to look up special use airspaces returned by the navigation log endpoint's SpecialUseAirspaceGlobalIds field.

typeCode.description: Type code (e.g., R for restricted, P for prohibited).

timesOfUse.description: Times of use for the airspace.

RouteBriefingResponse.description:
Composite weather briefing for a flight route, containing all weather products
affecting the route corridor.

corridorWidthNm.description: Corridor width in nautical miles used for the search.

generatedAt.description: UTC timestamp when the briefing was generated.

metars.description: METARs for airports found along the route corridor.

tafs.description: TAFs for airports found along the route corridor.

sigmets.description: SIGMETs whose boundaries intersect the route.

gAirmets.description: G-AIRMETs whose boundaries intersect the route.

notams.description: Active NOTAMs within the route corridor.

summary.description: Summary counts for each weather product category.

MetarDto.description: METAR (Meteorological Aerodrome Report) observation data for an airport.

rawText.description: Raw METAR text string as received from the source.

windDirDegrees.description: Wind direction in degrees true, or "VRB" for variable.

altimInHg.description: Altimeter setting in inches of mercury.

seaLevelPressureMb.description: Sea level pressure in millibars. ex: 1016.2

qualityControlFlags.description: Quality control flags for the observation.

wxString.description: Present weather string (e.g., "-RA" for light rain).

skyCondition.description: Sky condition layers (cloud cover and bases).

flightCategory.description: Flight category: VFR, MVFR, IFR, or LIFR.

MetarQualityControlFlagsDto.description: Quality control flags indicating METAR observation characteristics.

MetarSkyConditionDto.description: A single sky condition layer in a METAR observation.

skyCover.description: Sky cover type: SKC (sky clear), CLR (clear below 12,000), FEW (few), SCT (scattered), BKN (broken), OVC (overcast), or OVX (obscured).

cloudBaseFtAgl.description: Cloud base height in feet AGL. Null for SKC or CLR.

TafDto.description: TAF (Terminal Aerodrome Forecast) data for an airport.

rawText.description: Raw TAF forecast text as received from the source. ex: KORD 061728Z 0618/0724 21012KT P6SM BKN250

issueTime.description: Time the TAF was issued in ISO 8601 format.

validTimeFrom.description: Start of the TAF valid period in ISO 8601 format.

validTimeTo.description: End of the TAF valid period in ISO 8601 format.

TafForecast.description:
A single forecast period within a TAF. Each TAF contains one or more forecast periods
covering different time ranges, with optional change indicators (TEMPO, BECMG, FM, PROB).

fcstTimeFrom.description: Start of this forecast period in ISO 8601 format (UTC).

fcstTimeTo.description: End of this forecast period in ISO 8601 format (UTC).

changeIndicator.description: Change indicator: FM (from), BECMG (becoming), TEMPO (temporary), or PROB (probability). Null for the base forecast.

timeBecoming.description: Time at which a BECMG (becoming) change completes, in ISO 8601 format (UTC).

probability.description: Probability percentage (e.g., 30 or 40) for PROB-type forecast periods.

windDirDegrees.description: Forecast wind direction in degrees true, or "VRB" for variable winds.

windGustKt.description: Forecast wind gust speed in knots.

windShearHgtFtAgl.description: Low-level wind shear height in feet AGL.

windShearDirDegrees.description: Low-level wind shear direction in degrees true.

windShearSpeedKt.description: Low-level wind shear speed in knots.

visibilityStatuteMi.description: Forecast visibility in statute miles. May contain "6+" for visibility greater than 6 miles.

altimInHg.description: Forecast altimeter setting in inches of mercury.

vertVisFt.description: Vertical visibility in feet, reported when the sky is obscured.

wxString.description: Forecast weather phenomena string (e.g., "-RA" for light rain, "+TSRA" for heavy thunderstorms with rain).

notDecoded.description: Portion of the TAF text that could not be decoded by the parser.

skyConditions.description: Forecast sky condition layers (cloud cover and bases) for this period.

turbulenceConditions.description: Forecast turbulence conditions for this period.

icingConditions.description: Forecast icing conditions for this period.

temperature.description: Forecast temperature data for this period.

TafSkyCondition.description: A single sky condition layer in a TAF forecast period.

skyCover.description: Sky cover type: CLR (clear), CAVOK (ceiling and visibility OK), FEW (few), SCT (scattered), BKN (broken), OVC (overcast), or OVX (obscured).

cloudBaseFtAgl.description: Cloud base height in feet AGL. Null for CLR or CAVOK.

cloudType.description: Cloud type modifier (e.g., CB for cumulonimbus, TCU for towering cumulus).

TafTurbulenceCondition.description: Forecast turbulence condition within a TAF forecast period.

turbulenceIntensity.description: Turbulence intensity code (integer 0-9 per TAF implementation table): 0 (none), 1 (light), 2 (moderate occasional), 3 (moderate frequent), 4 (severe), 5 (extreme), 6-8 (reserved), 9 (not specified), or X (mountain wave).

turbulenceMinAltFtAgl.description: Bottom of the turbulence layer in feet AGL.

turbulenceMaxAltFtAgl.description: Top of the turbulence layer in feet AGL.

TafIcingCondition.description: Forecast icing condition within a TAF forecast period.

icingIntensity.description: Icing intensity code: 0 (none), 1 (light), 2 (light in clouds), 3 (light in precipitation), 4 (moderate), 5 (moderate in clouds), 6 (moderate in precipitation), 7 (severe), 8 (severe in clouds), 9 (severe in precipitation).

icingMinAltFtAgl.description: Bottom of the icing layer in feet AGL.

icingMaxAltFtAgl.description: Top of the icing layer in feet AGL.

TafTemperature.description: Forecast temperature data within a TAF forecast period.

validTime.description: Valid time for this temperature forecast in ISO 8601 format (UTC).

sfcTempC.description: Forecast surface temperature in degrees Celsius.

maxTempC.description: Forecast maximum temperature in degrees Celsius.

minTempC.description: Forecast minimum temperature in degrees Celsius.

PirepDto.description: PIREP (Pilot Report) data including turbulence, icing, and sky conditions.

qualityControlFlags.description: Quality control flags for the report.

aircraftRef.description: Aircraft type designation. ex: B738, C172

latitude.description: Latitude of the report in decimal degrees.

longitude.description: Longitude of the report in decimal degrees.

altitudeFtMsl.description: Altitude of the report in feet MSL.

reportType.description: Report type: UA (routine PIREP) or UUA (urgent PIREP).

PirepQualityControlFlags.description: Quality control flags indicating potential data issues with a PIREP.

midPointAssumed.description: The report location was assumed to be the midpoint of the route.

noTimeStamp.description: The report had no timestamp and was assigned one by the system.

fltLvlRange.description: The flight level was reported as a range rather than a single altitude.

aboveGroundLevelIndicated.description: The altitude was indicated as AGL rather than the standard MSL.

badLocation.description: The reported location could not be reliably decoded.

PirepSkyCondition.description: A sky condition layer reported by a pilot in a PIREP.

skyCover.description: Sky cover type: SKC (sky clear), CLR (clear), FEW (few), SCT (scattered), BKN (broken), OVC (overcast), or OVX (obscured).

cloudBaseFtMsl.description: Cloud base altitude in feet MSL (note: PIREP altitudes are MSL, unlike TAF/METAR which use AGL).

cloudTopFtMsl.description: Cloud top altitude in feet MSL.

PirepTurbulenceCondition.description: A turbulence condition reported by a pilot in a PIREP.

turbulenceType.description: Turbulence type: CAT (clear air), CHOP (chop), LLWS (low-level wind shear), or MWAVE (mountain wave).

turbulenceIntensity.description: Turbulence intensity: NEG (none), SMTH-LGT (smooth to light), LGT (light), LGT-MOD (light to moderate), MOD (moderate), MOD-SEV (moderate to severe), SEV (severe), SEV-EXTM (severe to extreme), or EXTM (extreme).

turbulenceBaseFtMsl.description: Bottom of the turbulence layer in feet MSL.

turbulenceTopFtMsl.description: Top of the turbulence layer in feet MSL.

turbulenceFreq.description: Turbulence frequency: ISOL (isolated), OCNL (occasional), or CONT (continuous).

PirepIcingCondition.description: An icing condition reported by a pilot in a PIREP.

icingType.description: Icing type: RIME (rime ice), CLEAR (clear ice), or MIXED (mixed rime and clear).

icingIntensity.description: Icing intensity: NEG (none), NEGclr (none, clear of clouds), TRC (trace), TRC-LGT (trace to light), LGT (light), LGT-MOD (light to moderate), MOD (moderate), MOD-SEV (moderate to severe), HVY (heavy/severe), or SEV (severe).

icingBaseFtMsl.description: Bottom of the icing layer in feet MSL.

icingTopFtMsl.description: Top of the icing layer in feet MSL.

SigmetDto.description: Domestic SIGMET advisory data including hazard information and affected area.

validTimeFrom.description: Start of the valid period in ISO 8601 format.

validTimeTo.description: End of the valid period in ISO 8601 format.

areas.description: Geographic areas affected by the advisory.

SigmetAltitude.description: Altitude range for a SIGMET advisory.

minFtMsl.description: Minimum altitude in feet MSL for the advisory area.

maxFtMsl.description: Maximum altitude in feet MSL for the advisory area.

SigmetHazardDto.description: Hazard type and severity information for a SIGMET advisory.

type.description: The weather hazard type: CONVECTIVE (thunderstorms/convection), ICE (icing), TURB (turbulence), IFR (instrument flight rules conditions), ASH (volcanic ash), or MTN_OBSCN (mountain obscuration).

severity.description: Hazard severity: LGT (light), LT-MOD (light to moderate), MOD (moderate, typical for AIRMET), MOD-SEV (moderate to severe), SEV (severe, typical for SIGMET). Convective SIGMETs do not have a severity value.

SigmetArea.description: Geographic area affected by a SIGMET, defined as a polygon of lat/lon points.

numPoints.description: Number of points defining the polygon boundary.

points.description: Ordered list of lat/lon points forming the polygon boundary of the affected area.

SigmetPoint.description: A geographic coordinate point forming part of a SIGMET area boundary polygon.

GAirmetDto.description: G-AIRMET (Graphical AIRMET) advisory data with hazard, altitude, and area information.

expireTime.description: Time the advisory expires, typically 6 hours after issuance.

validTime.description: The valid time of the G-AIRMET snapshot.

product.description: Product type: SIERRA, TANGO, or ZULU.

forecastHour.description: The forecast hour taken from initial product issuance. ex: 0, 3, 6, 9, 12

hazard.description: Hazard type: IFR, MT_OBSC, TURB_HI, TURB_LO, ICE, FZLVL, M_FZLVL, SFC_WIND, or LLWS.

geometryType.description: The geometry type: AREA or LINE.

dueTo.description: Additional information, reason for the AIRMET. ex: CIG BLW 010/VIS BLW 3SM PCPN/BR/FG

altitudes.description: Altitude ranges for the advisory in feet MSL. 0 indicates surface, -1 indicates freezing level.

area.description: Geographic area affected by the advisory.

GAirmetAltitude.description: Altitude information for a G-AIRMET advisory. Bottom/top levels valid in feet MSL; 0 indicates surface, -1 indicates freezing level.

minFtMsl.description: Minimum altitude in feet MSL. 0 indicates surface, -1 indicates freezing level.

levelFtMsl.description: Single level altitude in feet MSL (used for freezing level lines).

fzlAltitude.description: Range of altitudes for freezing level within an icing AIRMET.

GAirmetFzlAltitude.description: Range of altitudes for the freezing level within an icing G-AIRMET.

minFtMsl.description: Minimum freezing level altitude in feet MSL.

maxFtMsl.description: Maximum freezing level altitude in feet MSL.

GAirmetArea.description: Geographic area affected by a G-AIRMET, defined as a polygon of lat/lon points.

numPoints.description: Number of points defining the polygon boundary.

points.description: Ordered list of lat/lon points forming the polygon boundary of the affected area.

GAirmetPoint.description: A geographic coordinate point forming part of a G-AIRMET area boundary polygon.

NotamDto.description:
Represents a NOTAM as a GeoJSON Feature from the NMS API.
See nms-api.yaml NmsNotamData schema for full specification.

geometry.description: GeoJSON geometry representing the NOTAM's geographic location or affected area (Point, Polygon, or GeometryCollection).

properties.description: NOTAM properties containing the core NOTAM data, detail fields, and translations.

NotamGeometryDto.description: GeoJSON geometry - can be Point, Polygon, or GeometryCollection

coordinates.description:
For Point: [lon, lat] array
For Polygon: array of coordinate rings
For GeometryCollection: null (use Geometries instead)

geometries.description: For GeometryCollection type - contains child geometries

NotamPropertiesDto.description: Properties of a NOTAM GeoJSON Feature containing the core NOTAM data.

coreNOTAMData.description: Core NOTAM data including the event metadata, detail fields, and translations.

CoreNotamDataDto.description: Core NOTAM data structure containing event metadata, the NOTAM detail, and any translations.

notamEvent.description: NOTAM event metadata (encoding format and scenario).

notam.description: The NOTAM detail fields including identifier, text, effective dates, location, and classification.

notamTranslation.description: NOTAM text translations in various formats (plain English, domestic format, ICAO format).

NotamDetailDto.description:
Core NOTAM detail fields per NMS API specification.
Classification values: INTERNATIONAL, MILITARY, LOCAL_MILITARY, DOMESTIC, FDC
Feature values: RWY, TWY, APRON, AD, OBST, NAV, COM, SVC, AIRSPACE, ODP, SID, STAR, CHART, DATA, DVA, IAP, VFP, ROUTE, SPECIAL, SECURITY
Series values: A, B, C, D, E, G, H, I, J, K, N, R, V, Z

number.description:
NOTAM number as returned by the NMS API. Typically a bare sequence number (e.g., "420", "3997")
but may include a month prefix (e.g., "01/123") for domestic NOTAMs or a series prefix
(e.g., "A1234/25") for ICAO NOTAMs. Stored as-is from the source; the denormalized
notam_number column on the entity strips any month prefix for indexed search.

series.description: ICAO series code (A, B, C, D, E, G, H, I, J, K, N, R, V, Z)

year.description: 4-digit NOTAM year (e.g., "2025"). Denormalized to the notam_year entity column for indexed search.

feature.description: Feature category: RWY, TWY, APRON, AD, OBST, NAV, COM, SVC, AIRSPACE, ODP, SID, STAR, CHART, DATA, DVA, IAP, VFP, ROUTE, SPECIAL, SECURITY

airportName.description: Airport/facility name (AIXM-only, e.g., "JOHN C TUNE"). Null for GeoJSON-sourced NOTAMs.

classification.description: Classification: INTERNATIONAL, MILITARY, LOCAL_MILITARY, DOMESTIC, FDC

accountId.description:
Accountability ID — the issuing office code (e.g., "BNA", "FDC", "CLT").
3-4 characters for domestic NOTAMs, up to 8 characters for AFTN.
Denormalized to the account_id entity column for indexed search.

originId.description: Origin identifier from FAA FNSE extension

NotamTranslationDto.description:
NOTAM translation in various formats.
Type values: LOCAL_FORMAT, ICAO

RouteBriefingSummary.description: Count summary for a route briefing response.

RouteBriefingRequest.description: Request for a composite route weather briefing along a flight path.

waypoints.description:
Ordered list of waypoints defining the flight route. Each waypoint is either an
airport identifier (ICAO code or FAA identifier) or a lat/lon coordinate pair.
At least two waypoints are required to define a route.

corridorWidthNm.description:
Corridor width in nautical miles on each side of the route centerline.
Used for PIREPs, NOTAMs, and airport searches. Default is 25 NM.

BriefingWaypoint.description:
A single waypoint in a briefing route. Specify either an airport identifier
or latitude/longitude coordinates.

airportIdentifier.description:
Airport ICAO code (e.g., KDFW) or FAA identifier (e.g., DFW).
If provided, latitude and longitude are ignored and looked up from the database.

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90). Required when AirportIdentifier is null.

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180). Required when AirportIdentifier is null.

ChartSupplementsResponseDto.description:
Airport information with all available chart supplement (formerly Airport/Facility Directory) pages.
Chart supplements contain detailed airport information including runway data, lighting, services,
NOTAMs, and other operational details published by the FAA. The PDF URLs are time-limited pre-signed URLs.

airportCity.description: City the airport is associated with.

airportCode.description: Airport ICAO code or FAA identifier used to query this data.

supplements.description: List of chart supplement PDF pages with time-limited download URLs. Multi-page supplements will have one entry per page.

ChartSupplementDto.description: A single chart supplement page with a time-limited pre-signed URL for PDF download.

pdfUrl.description: Pre-signed URL to download the chart supplement PDF page. This URL expires after a limited time period; request a new URL if it has expired.

PaginatedResponseOfCommunicationFrequenc.description:
Cursor-based paginated response wrapper. To retrieve subsequent pages, pass the
pagination.nextCursor value as the cursor query parameter in your next request.
Continue until pagination.hasMore is false.

pagination.description: Pagination metadata including the cursor to fetch the next page.

CommunicationFrequencyDto.description:
Communication frequency data from the FAA NASR database, sourced from the FRQ CSV file.
Contains radio frequencies for ATC facilities, towers, approach/departure control, and other aviation communication services.

facilityCode.description: FAA NASR field: FACILITY. Contains FACILITY ID except for FACILITY TYPE AFIS, CTAF, GCO, UNICOM and RCAG. The FACILITY NAME is used for RCAG sites. AFIS, CTAF, GCO and UNICOM are NULL.

effectiveDate.description: FAA NASR field: EFF_DATE. The 28 Day NASR Subscription Effective Date (YYYY/MM/DD).

facilityName.description: FAA NASR field: FAC_NAME. Official Facility Name. NULL for AFIS, CTAF, GCO, UNICOM (no FACILITY ID or NAME in NASR) and ASOS/AWOS (no FACILITY NAME in NASR).

facilityType.description: FAA NASR field: FACILITY_TYPE. All records contain a FACILITY TYPE. Note: RCO and RCO1 serve the same function (remote communication outlet). An RCO1 may exist if two separate sites share the same identifier.

artccOrFssId.description: FAA NASR field: ARTCC_OR_FSS_ID. RCAG facilities contain an ARTCC ID; RCO/RCO1 facilities contain an FSS ID. Included for convenience to identify the parent ARTCC or FSS resource in NASR.

cpdlc.description: FAA NASR field: CPDLC. A Controller Pilot Data Link Communications (CPDLC) remark associated with a FACILITY.

towerHours.description: FAA NASR field: TOWER_HRS. Tower operating hours. Only listed for ATCT FACILITY TYPEs where the FACILITY equals the SERVICED FACILITY.

servicedFacility.description: FAA NASR field: SERVICED_FACILITY. The FACILITY ID (or FACILITY NAME if FACILITY TYPE is RCAG) that is serviced by the frequencies listed. This is a NON-NULL field.

servicedFacilityName.description: FAA NASR field: SERVICED_FAC_NAME. The FACILITY NAME that is serviced by the frequencies listed.

servicedSiteType.description: FAA NASR field: SERVICED_SITE_TYPE. Facility Type of SERVICED FACILITY.

latitude.description: FAA NASR field: LAT_DECIMAL. Facility Reference Point Latitude in Decimal Format.

longitude.description: FAA NASR field: LONG_DECIMAL. Facility Reference Point Longitude in Decimal Format.

servicedCity.description: FAA NASR field: SERVICED_CITY. Serviced Facility Associated City Name.

servicedState.description: FAA NASR field: SERVICED_STATE. Two-letter state ID of the SERVICED FACILITY.

servicedCountry.description: FAA NASR field: SERVICED_COUNTRY. Country Post Office Code of Serviced Facility.

towerOrCommCall.description: FAA NASR field: TOWER_OR_COMM_CALL. Radio call used by pilot to contact ATC or FSS facility.

primaryApproachRadioCall.description: FAA NASR field: PRIMARY_APPROACH_RADIO_CALL. Radio call of facility that furnishes primary approach control.

frequency.description: FAA NASR field: FREQ. Frequency for SERVICED FACILITY use. In the case of a NAVAID with DME/TACAN Channel, the Frequency is displayed with the Channel (FREQ/CHAN).

sectorization.description: FAA NASR field: SECTORIZATION. Sectorization based on SERVICED FACILITY or airway boundaries, or limitations based on runway usage. For ARTCC and RCAG, identifies the Frequency Altitude as Low, High, Low/High or Ultra-High.

frequencyUse.description: FAA NASR field: FREQ_USE. Intended use of the frequency (e.g., ATIS, LCL/P (Local/Tower), GND/P (Ground), CD/P (Clearance Delivery), APCH/P (Approach), DEP/P (Departure)).

remark.description: FAA NASR field: REMARK. Remark Text (Free Form Text that further describes a specific Information Item).

AirportCrosswindResponseDto.description: Response DTO containing crosswind components for all runways at an airport

airportIdentifier.description: ICAO code or identifier of the airport

windDirectionDegrees.description: Wind direction in degrees from METAR (null if variable)

windSpeedKt.description: Wind speed in knots from METAR

windGustKt.description: Wind gust speed in knots from METAR (if reported)

isVariableWind.description: Whether the wind was reported as variable (VRB)

runways.description: Crosswind components for each runway end at the airport

recommendedRunway.description: Recommended runway end identifier (lowest crosswind with headwind)

RunwayCrosswindComponentDto.description: Crosswind component data for a single runway end

crosswindKt.description: Crosswind component in knots. Positive = from the right, Negative = from the left

headwindKt.description: Headwind component in knots. Positive = headwind, Negative = tailwind

gustCrosswindKt.description: Crosswind component from gusts in knots (if gust data available). Positive = from the right

gustHeadwindKt.description: Headwind component from gusts in knots (if gust data available). Positive = headwind

absoluteCrosswindKt.description: Absolute value of crosswind component (for comparison purposes)

hasHeadwind.description: Whether this runway has a headwind (favorable) vs tailwind

CrosswindCalculationResponseDto.description: Response DTO for a single crosswind calculation

crosswindKt.description: Crosswind component in knots. Positive = from the right, Negative = from the left

headwindKt.description: Headwind component in knots. Positive = headwind, Negative = tailwind

gustCrosswindKt.description: Crosswind component from gusts in knots (if gust data provided). Positive = from the right

gustHeadwindKt.description: Headwind component from gusts in knots (if gust data provided). Positive = headwind

windGustKt.description: Wind gust speed used in calculation (knots)

isVariableWind.description: Whether the wind was reported as variable (VRB)

CrosswindCalculationRequestDto.description: Request DTO for manual crosswind calculation with user-provided parameters

windDirectionDegrees.description: Wind direction in degrees (0-360, or null for variable)

DensityAltitudeResponseDto.description: Response DTO for density altitude calculation

isaTemperatureCelsius.description: Standard (ISA) temperature at this pressure altitude in Celsius

temperatureDeviationCelsius.description: Temperature deviation from ISA in Celsius

rawMetar.description: Raw METAR text for reference (for airport-based calculations)

DensityAltitudeRequestDto.description: Request DTO for manual density altitude calculation

altimeterInHg.description: Altimeter setting in inches of mercury (inHg)

WindTriangleResponseDto.description: Response DTO for wind triangle calculation containing heading and ground speed results.

trueHeadingDegrees.description: True heading in degrees (0–360), corrected for wind

windCorrectionAngleDegrees.description: Wind correction angle in degrees (positive = right correction, negative = left)

headwindComponentKt.description: Headwind component in knots (positive = headwind, negative = tailwind)

crosswindComponentKt.description: Crosswind component in knots (positive = from the right, negative = from the left)

WindTriangleRequestDto.description: Request DTO for wind triangle (heading and ground speed) calculation.

trueAirspeedKt.description: True airspeed in knots (must be greater than 0)

TrueAirspeedResponseDto.description: Response DTO for true airspeed calculation.

densityAltitudeFt.description: Density altitude in feet at the given conditions

machNumber.description: Mach number at the given conditions

outsideAirTemperatureCelsius.description: Outside air temperature used in calculation (°C)

TrueAirspeedRequestDto.description: Request DTO for true airspeed (TAS) calculation.

calibratedAirspeedKt.description: Calibrated (indicated) airspeed in knots (must be greater than 0)

pressureAltitudeFt.description: Pressure altitude in feet (can be negative, e.g. Death Valley)

outsideAirTemperatureCelsius.description: Outside air temperature in degrees Celsius

CloudBaseResponseDto.description: Response DTO for cloud base estimation.

estimatedCloudBaseFtAgl.description: Estimated cloud base in feet AGL

CloudBaseRequestDto.description: Request DTO for cloud base estimation.

dewpointCelsius.description: Dewpoint temperature in degrees Celsius (must be ≤ temperature)

PressureAltitudeResponseDto.description: Response DTO for standalone pressure altitude calculation.

altimeterCorrectionFt.description: Altimeter correction — deviation from standard pressure expressed in feet

NavlogResponseDto.description:
Complete navigation log calculation result for a VFR cross-country flight.
Includes per-leg calculations (course, speed, fuel, wind) and references to airspace and obstacle
data along the route. Use the returned identifiers with the Airspace and Obstacle endpoints to
retrieve full details about en-route hazards.

totalRouteDistance.description: Total route distance in nautical miles (sum of all leg distances).

totalRouteTimeHours.description: Total estimated en-route time in hours (including climb and descent phases).

totalFuelUsed.description: Total fuel consumed for the entire route in gallons (including start/taxi/takeoff fuel).

averageWindComponent.description: Average wind component across all legs in knots. Negative values indicate a net headwind; positive values indicate a net tailwind.

legs.description: Ordered list of navigation legs between each pair of consecutive waypoints, containing computed course, speed, fuel, and wind data.

airspaceGlobalIds.description:
Global IDs of controlled airspaces (Class B, C, D, E) that the route passes through.
Use these IDs with the GET /api/v1/airspaces/by-global-ids?globalIds=... endpoint to retrieve full airspace details including boundaries and altitude limits.

specialUseAirspaceGlobalIds.description:
Global IDs of special use airspaces (restricted, prohibited, MOA, warning, alert) that the route passes through.
Use these IDs with the GET /api/v1/airspaces/special-use/by-global-ids?globalIds=... endpoint to retrieve full airspace details including boundaries and altitude limits.

obstacleOasNumbers.description:
OAS (Obstacle Assessment Surface) numbers of obstacles near the route.
Use these numbers with the POST /api/v1/obstacles/by-oas-numbers endpoint to retrieve full obstacle details including type, height, and lighting.
